summary: Comprehensive testing of SMLMS backend (22 pytest cases) and Expo frontend (login, home dashboard, search, book detail, borrow, library tabs, profile, scan, librarian login). Backend: 22/22 pass (100%). Frontend: all tested flows render and function correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport. Borrow flow verified by UI (available copies decreased 3->2) and backend.

issues: Expo web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Non-blocking but worth cleaning up in theme/styles for RN Web.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow equivalents or use Platform.select to silence web warnings.
(Optional) Add testID to bottom tab bar items (e.g. tab-home, tab-search, tab-library, tab-profile) for easier automation; currently tests have to tap tabs by text label.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via strip_mongo helper — good.
Seeding is idempotent (users keyed on email, books keyed on ISBN).
JWT_SECRET has an insecure default; main agent should move to env-only in production.
All endpoints use proper status codes (401/403/404/409) with meaningful messages.
borrow endpoint correctly prevents duplicate active loans and respects total_copies.
Reservation queue_position incremented atomically on insert; cancellation sets status='cancelled'.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; relied on 20 seeded books + 2 seeded users. One ephemeral TEST_ librarian book created & deleted during CRUD test (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is in frontend/.env. Login testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Tabs do NOT have testIDs — click them via page.get_by_text('Search'/'Library'/'Profile'/'Home', exact=True).first.click(force=True). Important screen testIDs: home-screen, search-screen, search-input, library-screen, library-tab-{active|history|holds}, profile-screen, go-librarian, logout-button, borrow-button, scan-fab, mock-scan-button, book-row-{id}. Note: bottom tabs are hidden on book detail screen (/book/[id]); use back button first.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Backend seed is idempotent and all role-based access rules enforced. Frontend login lands on home with greeting, Currently borrowed, Trending picks, Quick actions and QR FAB visible. Borrow flow decremented available_copies as expected.
